description: This file defines a Flutter widget called NoteDetailPage, which displays the details of a note, including title, content, and last updated timestamp. It also provides functionalities to edit or delete the note, with confirmation dialog for delete action.

classes.name: NoteDetailPage
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays details of a Note object, with options to edit or delete.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog to the user before deleting a note. Calls onDelete callback if confirmed.

methods.name: _formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string of format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.
